title: Ethan's Combat Textures
description: This resource pack adds 10+ new textures, including battleaxes, dagger-swords, a revamped apple texture (to make it look like a mango [it is not accurate but i like it]) grape berry bushes and more!
body:
This resource pack adds 10+ new textures, including battleaxes, dagger-swords, a revamped apple texture (to make it look like a mango [it is not accurate but i like it]) grape berry bushes, a mace that looks like Thor's hammer (from movies anyway) and more!


How to Download: 
1) Go to versions.
2) select version 1.21.11 and click it.
3) press 'download'
4) select the downloads button in you browser.
5) open your minecraft launcher, press installations and press the folder button (open installations button) or the Folder symbol.
6) drag the resource pack to the 'resourcepacks' folder.
7) let go of the resource pack.

To Use: 
open minecraft: Java Edition. 
Press the options button in the menu.
Press the 'resource packs' button.
select the 'Ethan's Combat Textures' and press the arrow facing the selected side of the screen.
play on a world and test the pack out!
